note: Held-out set written on 2026-11-10 by an independent writer from a brief, without seeing the question wording. The question under test is 'who is it about?', with script points that are themselves about OTHER parties. Each case is one decide request with ONE script point and a spoken transcript of one or two sentences in which the point's own words (or close paraphrases) appear, so that only the party decides. Categories, 8 cases each: O001-O008 general-others (true), O009-O016 named-group (true), O017-O024 named-third-party (true), O025-O032 others-and-us (true), O033-O040 others-point-said-of-us (false), O041-O048 group-swap (false), O049-O056 own-point-said-of-others-customers (false), O057-O064 wrong-named-party (false). Convention: covered is true only when the speaker says it of the same party the point means.
